as_told.title: Pentagon redacts Jake Barber's book Sentinels of Ether

plain: A man named Jake Barber says he tested what the Pentagon wanted kept secret by writing a 120,000-word historical novel built from real material and sending it to DOPSR, the Pentagon office that reviews writing by former personnel before it can be published, to "run an interrogation of the Department of Defense and its private partners." Michels, retelling it several times, calls the book Sentinels of Ether and says the Pentagon spent six months on just 20 pages and sent two chapters back heavily blacked out. For Michels, what was cut shows which parts of the story were true.
